applies_to: Shinko PCA1 programmable controllers with the C or C5 serial option; manual No. PCA1CE3.
summary: The PCA1 is a ramp/soak controller with 16 patterns of 16 steps that draw their PID, wait, alarm, output and time-signal settings from numbered blocks. On RS-485 it speaks Shinko protocol or Modbus ASCII/RTU; every item is a signed 16-bit holding register. The map covers general settings, run/hold/advance commands, monitor values, every block table and the per-pattern repeat/link items; step items are listed for pattern 0, step 0 with the rule for the rest.

addressing.note: Data items are hex (0080H, 1000H) and are sent unchanged as the Modbus holding-register address. The manual says the Modicon number is the data item plus 40001. The RTU examples read PV at 0080H and pattern 0 step 0 SV at 1000H (CRCs 85E2H and 80CAH checked).

source.title: Communication Instruction Manual PCA1 (C, C5)
source.pages: Command table pp. 21-37; data notes p. 38; communication settings p. 4

notes: Step items: address = 1000H + pattern x 100H + step x 10H + item, pattern and step 0-F, item 0 (SV) to D (output block). Only pattern 0, step 0 is listed here; all 256 steps use the same item layout.
Block items: PID 2k00H-2k04H, wait 3k00H, alarm 4k00H-4k03H, output 5k00H-5k04H (k = block 0-9), time signal 6k00H-6k01H (k = 0-F), repetitions/link 7p00H-7p01H (p = pattern 0-F).
All data are 16-bit two's complement; values with a decimal point are sent as whole numbers.
Units of PID times, limits and MV are not printed in the command table.

integration.summary: Select MODBUS RTU in the Communication Parameter Setting Group and give the unit a non-zero instrument number; then poll PV 0080H, current step SV 0083H, pattern/step 0085H and status 0086H-0088H, and run/stop the program with 0042H.
integration.enable: Requires the C or C5 option. In the Communication Parameter Setting Group set Communication protocol to MODBUS RTU (or ASCII), then instrument number, speed, data bit/parity and stop bit; these are keypad-only.
quirks: The manual's Modicon example writes 1000H as 41001, treating the hex digits as decimal; its example frames send 1000H itself as the PDU address (CRCs check), so use the hex data item directly.
Instrument number 0 is the Modbus broadcast address; give each unit 1-95.
Serial communication and the USB console cable cannot be used at the same time.
setup: Factory defaults: Shinko protocol, instrument number 0, 9600 bps, 7 bits/even parity, 1 stop bit, 10 ms response delay.
For Modbus RTU choose an 8-bit data format.
gotchas: HOLD, ADVANCE and PREVIOUS STEP return exception 17 (11H) in program standby.
Multi-register writes to non-existent or out-of-range items are acknowledged but discarded; check by reading back.
